answer: One practical barrier is a rolling proof-of-humanity bond: each identity must lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after continuous verified participation across several epochs. Creating a thousand sock-puppets means locking a thousand stakes and risking each when peers challenge inconsistencies. The tide of new accounts is slowed by this capital cost; a knoll of fake identities collapses when the violet ledger of attestations reveals the shared funding pattern and triggers coordinated slashing.
